_comment: Sources for the no-placeholder claim, one entry per basis. Each zone in zones-index.json names one of these by id in placeholders_source_id, and the rendered confidence is DERIVED from the tier here rather than typed beside the claim. Written 18 Aug 2026 after an audit found the claim mis-sourced on ten zones at once: a single boolean was covering a tier-1 patch note, a tier-2 wiki revision and nothing at all, and it could not tell them apart. That is the identical fault CLAUDE.md section 2 records for the Sky tracker's `v` flag, and the remedy is the same one skydata.py already applies - a claim names its source, and the badge is derived, never typed.

patch-2026-07-28.title: Natch Potes - July 28, 2026 (EverQuest Legends Launch Day Patch)
patch-2026-07-28.quote: Removed placeholders from and lowered maximum respawn times in several dungeons: The Hole, Nagafen's Lair, Lower Guk, Lair of the Splitpaw, The Warrens, Castle Mistmoore. More dungeon treatments will take place over time.
patch-2026-07-28.note: SIX zones, named individually. Read in a real browser on 18 Aug 2026 and stored verbatim at the path above. The list is closed - the note names no others, and it does not mention Upper Guk. This site claimed for weeks that it named eleven, or ten plus Upper Guk; it named six.

patch-2026-06-23.title: 23 June 2026 revamp notes
patch-2026-06-23.quote: a striking lack of placeholders for named mobs
patch-2026-06-23.note: NOT PUBLICLY FETCHABLE, checked 18 Aug 2026. everquestlegends.com/patch-notes lists six notes and its oldest is 7 July 2026 (Beta); probes for 6-16, 6-23 and 6-30 all fall through to the site's Home view, which is how that single-page app answers a path that does not exist. The quote has been carried in Najena's own provenance block since that survey was written, and it is beta-era - the game launched 28 July. So the strongest source we hold for Najena is one a reader cannot check. That is recorded here rather than smoothed over, and it is the open question on this claim.

eqlwiki-cat-named-155553.title: eqlwiki Category:Named Mobs
eqlwiki-cat-named-155553.quote: In EQLegends, named mob placeholders do not spawn in the revamped dungeons (e.g., Befallen, Blackburrow, Najena); the named mob(s) will spawn every time.
eqlwiki-cat-named-155553.note: Passes the CLAUDE.md section 2 provenance test: named 2026 editor, dated revision, structured category page, explicitly about Legends, not a Project 1999 import. It is tier 2 and it predates launch by eighteen days, so it is beta-era knowledge about a pre-launch state. It is a real source and it is weaker than a patch note - which is exactly what the rendered line must say.
